the preferred orientation in lamellar structure can be obtained by preheating the casting shell in a certain temperature range,and the reliability of turbine blades can be evaluated by testing the plate with the same microstructure.

the preheated temperature range of casting shell is 400~600℃ for complete filling up of the mould and ensuring the preferred orientation of the lamellar structure in the blades parallel with casting surface.

the casting shell preheated temperature is an important factor for the formation of the lamellar microstructures with preferred orientation in the blades and the reliability of the Ti-Al turbine blades.
